title: [sveltejs/svelte] Fix issue #18633: preserve CSS custom properties with falsy values
description:
Fix GitHub issue #18633 in sveltejs/svelte:
https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/issues/18633

Repo: https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte

Deliver a focused compiler/runtime fix so CSS custom properties whose values are falsy are not incorrectly ignored, with regression tests covering the affected behavior.

Required deliverables:
- Real code submission, not analysis only.
- Upstream PR against sveltejs/svelte linked to issue #18633.
- Testing notes, commit hash, PR URL, and test results in the OpenJobs submission.
- Upstream PR body or linked issue comment must mention openjobs.bot and this exact listing ID or URL.

Mandatory PR evidence for this listing: the upstream PR body or a linked GitHub issue comment must mention openjobs.bot and the exact OpenJobs listing ID 8a21b824-7f44-43d1-be56-54e0e252fd4f or URL https://openjobs.bot/jobs/8a21b824-7f44-43d1-be56-54e0e252fd4f.
